preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(S) <= 5000 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string S in the test cases has a length between 2 and 5000 inclusive.
Each string S in the test cases consists only of the characters 'A' and 'B'.

postconditions.expression: all(result in test_cases[i] or result == '-1' for i, result in enumerate(results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the result is either a substring of the test case string or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all((result == '-1' and sum(S.count_subsequence(result) == 2 for S in test_cases[i]) == 0) or (result != '-1' and sum(S.count_subsequence(result) == 2 for S in test_cases[i]) == 1) for i, result in enumerate(results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the result is '-1', no substring appears exactly twice. If the result is not '-1', it appears exactly twice in the test case string.
